<STRUCT_0001>
Potpourri of other papers.
<STRUCT_0002>
<STRUCT_0003> Lieblich: <EMPHOPEN_0001>Moduli of twisted sheaves<EMPHCLOSE_0001> <REF_0001>
<STRUCT_0004>
This paper contains a summary of gerbes and twisted sheaves.
If <MATH_0001> is a <MATH_0002>-gerbe with <MATH_0003> a projective
relative surface with smooth connected geometric fibers, it is shown that
the stack of semistable <MATH_0004>-twisted sheaves is an Artin stack
locally of finite presentation over <MATH_0005>. This paper also develops the
theory of associated points and purity of sheaves on Artin stacks.
<STRUCT_0005>
<STRUCT_0006> Lieblich, Osserman:
<EMPHOPEN_0002>Functorial reconstruction theorem for stacks<EMPHCLOSE_0002>
<REF_0002>
<STRUCT_0007>
Proves some surprising and interesting results on
when an algebraic stack can be reconstructed from its associated functor.
<STRUCT_0008>
<STRUCT_0009> David Rydh:
<EMPHOPEN_0003>Noetherian approximation of algebraic spaces and stacks<EMPHCLOSE_0003>
<REF_0003>
<STRUCT_0010>
This paper shows that every quasi-compact algebraic stack
with quasi-finite diagonal can be approximated by a Noetherian stack.
There are applications to removing the Noetherian hypothesis in results
of Chevalley, Serre, Zariski and Chow.
